contract: THE cross-repo narration contract; the worker, the API and the app each assert this file, so a change on one side fails a test on the others instead of quietly ending premium narration. `lines` is the read-aloud script both the app and the worker must reproduce exactly. `canonical` is the single-clip space join the pre-rendered audio speaks (worker only — the app utters the lines as separate utterances). `textHash` is the FULL lowercase-hex sha256 of the spoken lines (glyph substitutions applied, empty lines dropped) joined by a single newline: it is the clip's staleness check, its on-device cache-key segment, and the `textHash` field on the wire. `wire` pins the endpoint, the queue message and a verbatim response sample.
